SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TO SUPPORT THE JEWISH COMMUNITY FOUNDATION'S EXEMPT PURPOSE.

THE FOUNDATION FOLLOWS GAAP RELATED TO THE RECOGNITION OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS. THE FOUNDATION RECOGNIZES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS PART OF THE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF ACTIVITIES AND CHANGES IN NET ASSETS, WHEN APPLICABLE. MANAGEMENT HAS DETERMINED THAT THE FOUNDATION HAS NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AT JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023, AND NO AMOUNTS HAVE BEEN ACCRUED. THE FOUNDATION FILES INFORMATIONAL AND INCOME TAX RETURNS IN THE UNITED STATES AND VARIOUS STATE AND LOCAL JURISDICTIONS.

GRANTS ARE PAID TO ORGANIZATIONS OUTSIDE THE U.S. THAT ALIGN WITH THE JEWISH COMMUNITY FOUNDATION OF SAN DIEGO'S MISSION TO INCREASE CURRENT AND FUTURE SUPPORT FOR A VIBRANT AND SECURE JEWISH COMMUNITY. GRANTS ARE APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A COMPLETE COPY OF THE FINAL FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY A DESIGNATED COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD PRIOR TO FILING THE RETURN. THE COMMITTEE MAKES A REPORT TO THE BOARD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION REQUIRES THAT EACH BOARD MEMBER DISCLOSE ALL CONFLICTS BY COMPLETING A CONFLICT OF INTEREST QUESTIONNAIRE. A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, ADOPTED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, IS DISTRIBUTED AND REVIEWED ANNUALLY. IF A TRANSACTION ARISES WHERE THERE IS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE PERSON WITH SUCH CONFLICT IS NOT ALLOWED TO VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION.
